overall_assessment: Reviewed all 28 packet entries (17 suspects and 11 random controls); no surviving personal data, substantive content loss or anonymization-induced structure damage was found in the supplied text, although two plans have explicit packet truncation markers. All ten name_like flags are false alarms from course/programme titles, organisations, places, formatting terminology or the named Thorvald Stoltenberg Seminar, and all six removed flags reflect appropriate timetable/contact removal with responsible units and reference authors retained. Both admin_date flags are genuine, and an additional unflagged English semester-year remains in SVF-6311; none of the random controls shows offering-specific administrative dating.

findings.evidence: Samling 1: Markedsstrategi - 28-30. nov. 2007 … Kull 2019 har studiested Bodø. … 15. mai 2019 … re-sit examination for students who fail early in the Spring semester 2009.
findings.description: Three of 28 plans retain offering-specific administrative dating. BED-6001 retains four dated teaching sessions in Undervisningsform, ranging from November 2007 to September 2008, even though its separate timetable block is removed. HEL-6308 retains the application deadline 15. mai 2019 and the cohort stamp Kull 2019. SVF-6311 retains Spring semester 2009 in its re-sit arrangements, a real date leak missed by the pre-pass because it was flagged only name_like. These dates identify particular offerings rather than literature, historical subject matter or government documents; the defect is occasional rather than institution-wide in this packet.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R: .anon_uit() removes the closing timetable block and numeric exam dates, but does not cover dated sessions embedded in teaching prose, year-bearing application deadlines or cohort stamps. In .anon_generic(), long-form dates are removed only in approval/update or timestamp contexts, administrative-year keywords omit Kull, and .season_regex requires the year immediately after an English season rather than allowing the intervening word semester.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the generic season-year pattern to accept English spring/autumn/fall semester YYYY. Add contextual UiT rules that remove full day/range-month-year dates after Samling N: topic and under Søknadsfrist, including abbreviated month names and cross-month ranges; retain the session topics and teaching methods. Normalize Kull YYYY to Kullet in cohort prose while retaining its location. Keep existing government-document and reference protections, and verify all three packet examples alongside unchanged reading-list years and yearless recurring course schedules.
